title: The integral (log) cotangent complex of extensions of valued fields
summary: Let $(L, v_L) / (K, v_K)$ be a finite or purely transcendental extension of real valued fields. We construct the associated integral cotangent and log cotangent complexes in terms of a MacLane-Vaquié chain approximating $v_L$. This leads to explicit formulas for associated invariants such as the (absolute) (log) different, weight norm and Kähler norm. As a corollary of our methods we obtain strong control of the higher homology of the integral (log) cotangent complex, generalizing an important result of Gabber and Ramero to the logarithmic setting.
